statement: On cejel #659, two counted controls from #657's item F, `go test ./...` on the check line and as the test script, were checks that cannot fail: the fixture held no `_test.go` file, so go prints "no test files" and exits 0. They were the passing side of the `-count=0` mutation pair, so the pair showed only that a flag was refused, never that the control could fail; ctest's control had the same flaw. Rule: a counted control is evidence only where the fixture holds what the check needs to fail. Give each control the smallest real test it runs; a control with nothing to run is a candidate exclusion, not a baseline. The same session also put a red count taken before a fixture edit into a commit message (the error of the 2026-11-02 seed on stating a result only after re-running it); the records give the re-run count.
